text: Pelulu
Dunder
Velly
Navida City
Vykon Music Hall: Entrance
So this is Vykon Meadow?\nThis place is more beautiful than I thought.
The flowers are so bright in color and beautiful.
The plants in Vykon Meadow are filled with magic\nenergy, so the flowers will bloom beautifully!\nThe trunks are thick and robust too!
We don't know what kind of instrument they wanna\nmake, so I guess the bigger the wood we find,\nthe better.
Huh? What? Did you see something?
You didn't see anything, but you heard something?
I didn't hear anything, though~.
Hey, what are you doing?\nGather the materials quickly!
Okay, okay!\nLet's hurry up and finish this!
Is this good enough?\nLook, this wood here looks like a flute, doesn't\nit?
Yeah, exactly!
A flute? Is it the instrument that makes a squeaky\nsound through a tube?
Huh?\nDoes it sound like that though~?
This big wood is perfect for a lute's body!
Well spotted, Lady Velly! It's perfect!
A lute? That's the instrument that produces sound\nwhen you hit it, right?
Er...\nActually, I don't really know…
Hmm~, I sometimes trade instruments too, but\nI don't really know much about them~.
Some kids want instruments as their Xmas presents,\nbut honestly, I barely know anything about them...
W-welp, asking the Great Spirit is the best thing\nto do! Let's head back to Navida City first!
Wait!\nWe still have time before meeting the Great\nSpirit!
No one will be mad even if we're loud here.\nLet's practice our vocals together!
Ack!
Ugh, what a pain~.\nWell, it's not like I hate singing, though.
Alright, let's begin!\nStraighten your back and open your throat!\nNow sing from your diaphragm!
Wait, wait!\nWe haven't finished gathering the ingredients yet!
